android.desc:
Apple TV is the home of exclusive Apple Original shows and movies, Formula 1®, MLS, Friday Night Baseball, and all the best entertainment from your favorite streaming services—all in one place.

With an Apple TV subscription:
• Stream thousands of hours of Apple Originals—thrilling dramas, epic sci-fi, and feel-good comedies, all with no ads—including Ted Lasso, Severance, The Morning Show, Silo, Shrinking, Slow Horses, and F1 The Movie.
• Enjoy new releases weekly, with no ads.
• Watch every Formula 1 Grand Prix™ live—with all-access coverage for every practice, qualifying, Sprint, and race.
• Watch Friday Night Baseball, with live MLB matchups every Friday of the regular season. 
• Watch every Major League Soccer match live throughout the regular season, the entire playoffs, and Leagues Cup, all with no blackouts.

Apple TV app makes watching all your TV easier:
• Get personalized recommendations across everything you watch.
• With Continue Watching, pick up where you left off across all your subscriptions and devices.
• Add to Watchlist to keep track of what you want to watch later.

Apple TV subscription does not include third party-branded subscription services or content available for rental or purchase in the Apple TV app.

In select regions, an Apple TV subscription may only be available as part of an iCloud+ subscription. If you subscribe to any Apple TV channels, payment will be charged to your Apple Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless they are canceled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Simultaneous streams may be limited on a per-subscription basis. The availability of Apple TV features, channels, and related content may vary depending on the country or region from which you attempt to access them. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your Settings on the Apple TV app after purchase. See https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww for the Privacy Policy. Apple TV app Terms and Conditions can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html
